P.name: Friend of the Forest
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Ivern''' cannot attack nor damage non-epic {{tip|monster|monsters}}. Instead, targeting a jungle camp initiates a {{fd|2.5}} second {{tip|channel}} that will plant a {{as|grove|buzzword2}} upon the camp. Placing a {{as|grove|buzzword2}} costs {{sti|health|{{as|{{pplevel|(15-(x-1)*0.882)/100*({{ccd|Ivern|hp_base}}+{{ccd|Ivern|hp_lvl}}*(x-1)*(0.7025+0.0175*(x-1)))|formula = (15% - 0.882% per level after 1) of base health}} health}}}} and {{sti|mana|{{as|{{pplevel|(20-(x-1)*1.175)/100*({{ccd|Ivern|mp_base}}+{{ccd|Ivern|mp_lvl}}*(x-1)*(0.7025+0.0175*(x-1)))|formula = (20% - 1.175% per level after 1) of base mana}} mana}}}}. The channel cannot be cancelled in the first {{fd|0.15}} seconds and in the last {{fd|0.5}} seconds.
P.description2: '''''Ivern''' cannot place a grove while he is affected by {{tip|cast-inhibiting crowd control}} or a {{tip|lockout}} that disables abilities.''
P.description3: The {{as|grove|buzzword2}} matures over {{pp|40;38;36;34;32;30;27;24;21;18;15;11;7;3;1|formula = 42 - 2 per level until level 6, then 3 until level 11, then 4 until level 15. ''This is capped at 1 second at level 15.''}} seconds. When fully matured, '''Ivern''' can target the camp again to ''free'' it after a {{fd|0.5}}-second [[cast time]], clearing the camp and receiving the {{tt|{{g|full gold}} and {{sti|experience|{{as|full experience}}}}|Not full when freeing Krug camp, see notes}} [[bounty|bounties]]. Using {{si|Smite}} on a monster within the {{as|grove|buzzword2}} will instantly ''free'' the camp regardless of maturity.
P.description4: If the camp's large monster has already been slain prior to planting a {{as|grove|buzzword2}}, '''Ivern''' will ''free'' the camp upon completing the channel at no cost. Similarly, the {{as|grove|buzzword2}} will instantly mature if the large monster is slain.

Q.name: Rootcaller
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ivern''' throws a vine in the target direction, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit and {{tip|root|rooting}} them for a duration, during which they are also {{tip|standard sight|revealed}}. ''Rootcaller'' can be recast while the target is {{tip|root|rooted}}.
Q.leveling:
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|80 to 260}} {{as|(+ 70% AP)}}}}
{{st|Root Duration|{{ap|1.6 to 2}} seconds}}
Q.description2: '''Ivern''' and allied champions can issue an {{tt|attack order|Default: MB2 / right-click}} against the target {{tip|root|rooted}} by ''Rootcaller'' to {{tip|dash}} to their location, stopping at {{sti|their attack range}}.
Q.description4: Hitting a non-epic monster reduces ''Rootcaller's'' {{sti|cooldown}} by 50%.

W.name: Brushmaker
W.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} While '''Ivern''' is in {{tip|brush}}, his basic attacks are empowered to fire a bolt at the target, dealing {{as|'''additional''' magic damage|magic damage}}. This bonus persists for 3 seconds after leaving brush.
W.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ivern''' grows a patch of {{tip|brush}} at the target location for 45 seconds, granting {{tip|sight}} of the area within and around it for 8 seconds. Brushes despawn instantly after allied {{tip|sight|vision}} within them is lost. Spawning brush near [[terrain]] or other brush increases its radius.
W.description3: While allied champions are in any {{tip|brush}} when '''Ivern''' is within {{tt|1000|Estimated}} units, their basic attacks are empowered to fire a bolt at the target, dealing {{as|'''additional''' magic damage|magic damage}}. This bonus persists for {{fd|1.5}} seconds after leaving brush.
W.leveling3: {{st|Ally Additional Magic Damage|{{ap|10 to 30}} {{as|(+ 10% of '''Ivern's''' AP)}}}}<!--not on-hit-->
W.description4: '''Ivern''' periodically [[stocks]] a ''Brushmaker'' charge, up to a maximum of 3.

E.name: Triggerseed
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ivern''' places a seed on the target allied champion, {{ui|Daisy}}, or himself, granting the target a {{tip|shield}} for 2 seconds.
E.description2: After 2 seconds, the seed explodes to deal {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies and {{tip|slow}} them for 2 seconds.
E.description3: If the seed does not damage an enemy champion and the shield persists by the end of the duration, the shield is reapplied for the same strength and duration without the explosion effect.

R.name: Daisy!
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ivern''' summons his sentinel friend {{ui|Daisy}} to his side, who lands 350 units away from him in the target direction and remains on the field for up to 45 seconds as a controllable {{tip|pet}}.
R.description2: ''Daisy!'' can be recast at any time while {{ui|Daisy}} is alive.
R.description3: {{sbc|Recast - Daisy, wait!:}} '''Ivern''' commands {{ui|Daisy}} to move to the target location. If cast on '''Ivern''', {{ui|Daisy}} will follow him.
R.description4: ''The recast of Daisy! can be used while affected by {{tip|cast-inhibiting crowd control}}. See [[Ivern#Pets|Pets]] for more details about {{ui|Daisy}}.''
